from pathlib import Path
import json,hashlib
names=['gpu_pack_training_single_'+x+'_mixed_accounting' for x in ['04','05','06','07']]
root=Path('logs/review/diag_pack_mixed_command_archive_01');root.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=False)
manifest={'scope':'Preserve original completed accounting with incompatible producer argv before exact original-producer rerun. No fees/physics rewritten.','artifacts':[]}
for name in names:
 result=Path('results')/(name+'.json');data=json.loads(result.read_text())
 assert data['_meta']['end'] and data['_meta']['exit_code']==0
 assert data['_meta']['command'][:4]==['python3','-u','-m','src.tools.pbs_mixed_accounting']
 for original in [result,Path('logs/runs')/(name+'.log'),Path('logs/runs')/(name+'.meta.json'),Path('logs/runs')/(name+'.diff')]:
  if not original.exists():continue
  b=original.read_bytes();saved=root/original.parent.name/original.name;saved.parent.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
  with saved.open('xb') as stream:stream.write(b)
  assert saved.read_bytes()==b
  manifest['artifacts'].append({'original_file':str(original),'archive_file':str(saved),'sha256':hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest(),'bytes':len(b)})
with (root/'manifest.json').open('x') as stream:json.dump(manifest,stream,indent=2);stream.write('\n')
print('PRESERVED_ACCOUNTING_COMMAND_RECORDS: '+json.dumps(manifest),flush=True)
